header.name: Cache-Control
header.description: Tells all caching mechanisms from server to client whether they may cache this object. It is measured in seconds

header.name: Content-Encoding
header.description: The type of encoding used on the data.

header.name: Content-Length
header.description: The length of the response body in octets (8-bit bytes)

header.name: Content-Type
header.description: The mime type of this content

header.name: Date
header.description: The date and time that the message was sent

header.name: Server
header.description: A name for the server

header.name: Vary
header.description: Tells downstream proxies how to match future request headers to decide whether the cached response can be used rather than requesting a fresh one from the origin server.

header.name: X-AspNet-Version
header.description: Custom header

header.name: X-Powered-By
header.description: Specifies the technology (ASP.NET, PHP, JBoss, e.g.) supporting the web application (version details are often in X-Runtime, X-Version, or X-AspNet-Version)

## INVOICE / 810 DOCUMENT VIA WEBSERVICE

This document describes usage of DMI’s 810 webservice for customers. The global namespace is “dmi=[http://portal.suppliesnet.net”](http://portal.suppliesnet.net”). Only SSL connections using TLS1.1 (or higher) are acceptable protocols.

#### Structure of Invoice Request

One Invoice request needs to contain the following request information:

- One and only one element with one element under it. Any condition outside of those described will result in error conditions.
    
- A valid ISA is also required to identify the requester, and the order being inquired about must be associated with that ISA  
    in our database.
    

**Note:** _This request is based on when the invoice was created. Due to timing of internal processes, an order that shipped__on a certain day may not have it’s invoice created until the following day. i.e. if you call for invoices created on 2015-09-09, it may contain invoices for orders that shipped on 2015-09-08._

#### Structure of Invoices Response

The root element is Invoices. It may contain an Errors node, in case there are any errors during the processing of the invoice request. Each error is indicated by a separate Error node within Errors. The Error node will always contain an error number and an error description. It may also contain nodes to indicate errors with the requester’s ISA, InvoiceCreateDate, or internal errors. A listing of all error numbers is provided at the end of this document for trading partners who may want to code against the error numbers. The response may contain multiple Invoice nodes.

#### Description of some of the elements

| **Element Name** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| InvoiceNumber | Our internal invoice ID |
| ReferenceNumber | Reference number listed on the invoice |
| InvoiceDate | Date that the Invoice was created |
| OrderNumber | Order number for the order, assigned by DM |
| OrderDate | Date the order was placed |
| PONumber | Contact/Dealer PO number from the order |
| InvoiceRank | The line item rank sent in with the order, or if none was sent in, system assigned rank |
| ProductNumber | Our OEM Number listed for the item |
| ProductReferenceNumber | Our Reference Number listed for the item |

#### Error Codes

| **Error Number** | **Error Description** |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | No Error |
| 1 | Problem connecting to database |
| 2 | No Data returned from method call |
| 3 | Failed to validate invoice request XML against schema |
| 4 | failed to validate Invoice response against schema |
| 5 | Error parsing inbound XML request |
| 6 | Invalid Requester ISA/Credentials |
| 7 | Invoice request must contain at least one InvoiceCreateDate element |
| 8 | Valid InvoiceCreateDate not found for Order |
| 9 | Unknown Error |
